sections.heading: Key Takeaways
sections.text: Key Takeaways HDPE stands for high-density polyethylene, a thermoplastic polymer with high strength-to-density ratio, excellent chemical resistance, and very low moisture absorption. HDPE material machines well on standard CNC equipment without coolant in most operations. HDPE plastic is FDA-compliant in food-grade grades, making it common in food processing equipment and cutting board applications. HDPE sheet is the most common stock form for machined flat components, available in thicknesses from 1.5mm to over 100mm. HDPE properties that matter most in industrial applications are chemical resistance, moisture resistance, impact toughness, and low coefficient of friction. HDPE is not the r...
